info.title: database-converter - converts a Pleasanter database between SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL.
info.description: Pleasanter の DB を、SQL Server・PostgreSQL・MySQL の間で相互に変換するコマンドラインツール。

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: show what would be copied; write nothing

options.name: --resume
options.description: skip tables recorded as completed; reload unfinished tables from the start

options.name: --tables
options.description: copy only these tables

options.name: --exclude-tables
options.description: do not copy these tables

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: rows per batch (default 1000, 1-100000)

options.name: --max-batch-bytes
options.description: also flush a batch at about N bytes (default 4194304)

options.name: --command-timeout
options.description: per-command timeout (default 600; 0 = no limit)

options.name: --disable-constraints
options.description: disable foreign keys on the target while copying

options.name: --cleanup-progress
options.description: drop the progress table (__DatabaseConverterProgress) after a fully successful run

options.name: --help
options.description: show this help

options.name: --version
options.description:
show the version
Exit codes: 0 = everything succeeded, 1 = failures occurred, 2 = invalid arguments.

options.name: --from
options.description: source DBMS: sqlserver | postgresql | mysql

options.name: --to
options.description: target DBMS (must differ from --from)

options.name: --source-connection-env
options.description: environment variable holding the source connection string

options.name: --source-connection-file
options.description: file whose first non-empty line is the source connection string

options.name: --source-connection-stdin
options.description: read the source connection string from standard input

options.name: --target-connection-env
options.description: (default: DBCONV_TARGET_CONNECTION)

options.name: --target-connection-stdin
options.description: (only one side can use standard input)
